scale_0p5.comparison_to_full_strength: Same true positives and false negatives as full strength, with 15 additional false positives.

scale_0p75.comparison_to_full_strength: Fifteen fewer false positives than full strength, but five lost true positives and five additional false negatives.

interpretation: The Q/O controller was behaviorally effective, but no fixed intermediate amplitude improved publisher-TRAIN-derived scene micro-F1 over full strength. The current error frontier cannot be crossed by globally shrinking the memory correction.

next_direction.immediate: Move upstream to adapter training with matched-donor negative-state contrast and explicit correct-state dropout, selecting checkpoints on a disjoint publisher-TRAIN-derived fit partition.
next_direction.required_gates: A candidate must beat its no-state and matched-donor controls, improve native scene micro-F1 over the frozen v9 adapter, and preserve attribution and narrative before any fresh validation replication.
next_direction.avoid: Do not spend the next run on another global inference-time scalar or open the sealed 73-row strength holdout.
